fd_rate.yr2024: STALE PRE-MERGER SNAPSHOT: Union Bank PLC's own site (unionbank.com.bd/profit-rate) still shows an MTDR profit-rate table 'Effective From 19-11-2024' listing 11.00% for 12 months & above. This predates the bank's FY2024 equity collapse (~-246bn) and its Aug-2026 merger into the new state-owned Sammilito Islami Bank PLC; it is NOT a reflection of current reality - Bangladesh Bank has since said Union/Sammilito depositors got only ~4% ex-gratia profit for 2024-2025 due to losses, with a 9.5% cap proposed for 2026 under the new entity (tbsnews.net). Recorded here as the last-published figure on the bank's own (still-live but unmaintained) site; treat as historical/stale, not a current market rate. https://www.unionbank.com.bd/profit-rate - accessed 2026-09-13.
